## Kyoto Family Trip Overview
A relaxed 5-day plan for **4 adults + 1 child** with temples, gentle pacing, one museum visit, and **one free half-day** built in. I’ve kept each day under a light walking load and centered meals around traditional Kyoto cuisine.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary
### Day 1: Arrival + Easy Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Kyoto, check in, and take a slow hotel-area break; keep this as a low-activity arrival day.
- Afternoon: Gentle start with **Yasaka Shrine** and a short stroll through **Maruyama Park**; skip any long side streets if the child is tired.
- Evening: Early dinner in Gion with **kaiseki** or **yudofu**; finish with a calm walk past **Hanamikoji Street** if energy allows.

### Day 2: Higashiyama Temples + Traditional Lunch
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** early for cooler weather and fewer crowds; use taxis between stops to keep walking light.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Sannenzaka** and **Ninenzaka** at an easy pace, then stop for a traditional lunch such as **tofu set meals** or **obanzai**.
- Evening: Quiet temple atmosphere at **Kodai-ji** or a nearby tea house, then an early return to the hotel.

### Day 3: Museum Day + Free Half-Day Rest
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Visit the **Kyoto National Museum** for your one museum day; keep the visit focused and about 1.5–2 hours.
- Afternoon: **Free half-day for rest** — nap, laundry, pool time, or a low-key café stop near the hotel.
- Evening: Optional short outing for **shojin ryori** or a simple Kyoto-style dinner; keep the evening flexible and unhurried.

### Day 4: Arashiyama Temples + Riverside Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Head to **Tenryu-ji** and the surrounding Arashiyama area; use the bamboo grove only if you want a short scenic walk.
- Afternoon: Slow lunch with **yuba**, **soba**, or a tofu specialty, then enjoy the **Katsura River** area or a short boat-side break.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for an easy dinner; choose a restaurant with seating that works well for a child.

### Day 5: Northern Kyoto Temples + Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early, when the light is best and the pace is calmer.
- Afternoon: If time remains, add **Ryoan-ji** for a peaceful garden visit; otherwise keep this as a packing and transfer buffer.
- Evening: Final dinner with a Kyoto specialty such as **kaiseki**, **tempura**, or **nishin soba**, then depart or prepare for the next leg.

## Relaxed Pace Plan
| Day | Main Focus | Walking Level | Meal Anchor | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Sep 18 | Arrival + Gion | Low | Kaiseki / yudofu | Gentle start, short evening only |
| Sep 19 | Higashiyama temples | Moderate | Tofu / obanzai | Use taxis to reduce steps |
| Sep 20 | Museum + rest | Low | Shojin ryori | Free half-day built in |
| Sep 21 | Arashiyama | Moderate | Yuba / soba | Scenic but still easy-paced |
| Sep 22 | Northern temples | Low–Moderate | Kyoto specialty dinner | Keep flexible for departure |

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Kyoto temple map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kyoto+temples)
Action: [Button: Kyoto transit planner](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kyoto+station)
Action: [Button: Kyoto family restaurants](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kyoto+traditional+restaurant)

## Sources
- Kyoto tourism overview: https://kyoto.travel/en
- Kyoto National Museum: https://www.kyohaku.go.jp/eng/
- Kiyomizu-dera official site: https://www.kiyomizudera.or.jp/en/
